name: libbpf
author: jm33-ng
comment: libbpf shared-library dependency backing the ebpf_* Linux Starlark builtins. Not runnable directly; declare it in another module's dependencies.
help: Dependency module only: provides the libbpf shared library that backs the ebpf_* Linux Starlark builtins. It has no entry point and cannot be run directly. Declare libbpf in another module's dependencies so the agent maps it on demand.
